text: For the fictional BrightDesk store, customers may request a refund within 14 days of delivery. An order number and proof of purchase are required. Refund decisions must be confirmed by a human support officer.

BrightDesk staff can reset their portal password by selecting Forgot Password on the sign-in page. A reset link is sent to their registered work email. Support staff never ask users to share passwords.

For BrightDesk invoice enquiries, customers should provide the invoice number. The accounts team reviews billing discrepancies within three business days. No payment adjustment is made automatically by this application.
BrightDesk provides shipment status through the order tracking page. If an order is delayed, customers should provide the order number to support for manual investigation.
